name: Aadhaar Address Update
description: Update the address associated with Aadhaar after a residential move.
steps: Open the official UIDAI Aadhaar update service.
Sign in using the supported authentication flow.
Submit the new address with valid supporting proof.
Save the service request acknowledgement and track the request.

name: Shift Voter Registration
description: Shift an existing electoral-roll entry to the new residence.
steps: Open the official Voter Service Portal.
Use Form 8 for shifting of residence.
Provide the new residence and required address proof.
Track the application through the voter portal.

name: Update Vehicle Registration Address
description: Update the registered owner's residential address for a vehicle.
steps: Open the official Parivahan service.
Locate the vehicle registration address-change service/Form 33 flow.
Submit the required vehicle and address documents.
Pay applicable fees and retain the acknowledgement.

name: Register as a Voter
description: Apply for inclusion in the electoral roll after becoming eligible to vote.
steps: Open the official Voter Service Portal.
Choose Form 6 for new voter registration.
Provide the requested personal and residence details.
Submit and track the application.

name: Recover / Access Aadhaar
description: Use UIDAI's official services when the physical Aadhaar document is unavailable.
steps: Open the official UIDAI website.
Use the available Aadhaar retrieval or download service.
Complete the requested identity verification.

name: Replace Lost Voter ID (EPIC)
description: Request replacement of a lost EPIC through the electoral services system.
steps: Open the official Voter Service Portal.
Use Form 8 for replacement of EPIC.
Submit the requested details and supporting material.
Track the application online.

name: Marriage Registration
description: Prototype placeholder for marriage registration. The exact authority and process depend on jurisdiction and applicable law.
documents: Jurisdiction-specific documents — verify with the competent authority
steps: Determine the competent state/local registration authority.
Verify the applicable law and document list.
Submit the application through the verified government channel.

name: Review Identity Documents After Marriage
description: Review whether identity records require updates following a change in personal details.
documents: Marriage certificate or other accepted supporting document — verify per service
steps: List identity records whose personal details changed.
Use each authority's official update process.
Do not submit documents until the authority's current requirements are verified.
